Messages.Author: Luis P. Duarte
Messages.Body:
Hi!

I have a doubt on Undead Persistence.

The card says:
"This vampire gets an optional press. When combat ends, or if 3 rounds of
combat pass
with no cards played..."

My interpretations is:
This vampire gets one (optional) press to continue combat and IF no player
plays a
card then the combat has a minimum of 3 rounds "extra". (This makes me
believe each
round as a press.)

Imagine that UP gives you only the first press and you must play extra
presses as
normal to continue combat. Then how can i get "3 rounds of combat with no
cards
played" as stated in the card text?

Thanx!
.- Luis....@ip.pt

Messages.Author: Joshua Duffin
Messages.Body:
In article <364c2...@news.ip.pt>,
"Luis P. Duarte" <Luis....@ip.pt> wrote:
[snip]

> Imagine that UP gives you only the first press and you must play extra
> presses as
> normal to continue combat. Then how can i get "3 rounds of combat with no
> cards
> played" as stated in the card text?

That would be, "If there's also been a Trap played." ^_^ My guess is that
the designers didn't want to make Trap/Undead Persistence too easy of a
torporizing combo. There's a ruling on the Rulemonger page for Undead
Persistence:

"Provides only one optional press. Any further pressing must come from other
cards. [TOM 951224] "

Josh

or maybe someone just went crazy with the cut&paste...

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
"Luis P. Duarte" <Luis....@ip.pt> wrote:

> I have a doubt on Undead Persistence.
>
> The card says:
> "This vampire gets an optional press. When combat ends, or if 3 rounds of
> combat pass
> with no cards played..."

Most current card text (Sabbat):

Prevent this vampire from going into torpor. This vampire gets an optional
press. When combat ends, or if 3 rounds of combat pass with no cards played,
this vampire is sent into torpor.

>
> My interpretations is:
> This vampire gets one (optional) press to continue combat and IF no player
> plays a
> card then the combat has a minimum of 3 rounds "extra". (This makes me
> believe each
> round as a press.)

You only get one press. Not one each round.

> Imagine that UP gives you only the first press and you must play extra
> presses as
> normal to continue combat.

This is correct.

> Then how can i get "3 rounds of combat with no
> cards
> played" as stated in the card text?

Use a Trap or Conquer the Beast. Or a combination of three of: Hawg, Mob
Connections, Rat's Warning, superior Shadow of the Beast, superior Shadow of
the Wolf, Mark of Damnation, Mind Tricks, Appolonius, and Marty Lechtansi.
